rationale_md: Canada enters this Group B encounter as slight favorites, backed by a modest 30-point Elo rating advantage over Bosnia-Herzegovina. The model gives the hosts nearly double the win probability of their opponents, reflecting both the home advantage and superior recent form. This opening group stage match should be competitive, though Canada's edge in both underlying metrics and match conditions makes them the team to beat.
